Chicken marinade:
* 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs
* 1 cup buttermilk
* 1/2 tsp: salt, pepper
* 1 tsp: chicken bouillon powder, cayenne, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika
* 2 tbs pickle juice
* Splash of hot sauce
* 1 egg
* Optional: 1/2 tsp msg

Dredge:
* 1.5 cups AP flour
* 1/2 cup cornstarch
* 1 tsp baking powder
* 1 tsp: salt, pepper, chicken bouillon powder, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika

Hot honey glaze:
* 1/2 stick unsalted butter
* 1/2 cup honey
* 1/4 cup hot sauce (to taste)
* 1/2 tsp: garlic powder, paprika, smoked paprika
* Optional: 1/2-1 tsp cayenne
* Salt to taste

Homemade buttermilk ranch:
* 1/2 cup mayo
* 1/2 cup sour cream
* 1/2 cup buttermilk
* 1 clove garlic, grated
* 2 tbs Hidden Valley Ranch seasoning
* Finely minced fresh dill and parsley (dried is fine)
* Salt and pepper to taste

For the sliders:
* 6 Brioche slider buns
* Dill pickles
* Garlic butter (1/2 stick butter, 2 cloves grated garlic, minced parsley)
